reasoning: Five related CSV files represent a classic e-commerce domain. The data is already well-normalised: users, categories (with self-referential hierarchy), products (FK to categories), orders (FK to users), and order_items (junction table with FKs to both orders and products). UUIDs are used throughout as primary and foreign keys. Enum candidates: orders.status (pending/processing/shipped/completed/cancelled) and orders.payment_method (credit_card/paypal/stripe), users.role (admin/customer/moderator). Several monetary columns (price, total_amount, unit_price, discount_amount) should be NUMERIC(10,2). Nullable fields identified from actual null values in the data: phone, avatar_url, compare_at_price, weight_kg, shipped_at, delivered_at, categories.parent_id (root nodes). The order_items table is a pure junction table.
